D/ IMP C CARAVSIVS P AVG

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Carausius (286-293), possibly C mint issue,. Obverse description: Radiate bust draped and cuirassed right, image possibly defaced. Obverse inscription: IMP C CARAVSIVS P AVG. Reverse description: Female figure standing left holding globe under her hand and transverse sceptre; C in right field. Reverse inscription: [--]P[[---]S G A. In exergue: C. Diameter: 24.1mm, Weight: 3.80gms, die axis: 6
